YuanDi response requests expose the server-provided remaining names; role updates separately store current collected names and the permanent remaining group.

XinYou Pri has ACTIVE only, NORMAL_BASIC, DISCARD, minimum one card and once-per-Play metadata. It exposes no ASK responder or second discard-selection cursor. This supports, but does not independently prove, the loop interpretation below.
Current XinYou extension par1=5/par2=1 supports the published five/one constants; it is not evidence of a second discard cursor.

implementationReadings.topic: Yuandi name group and historical scope
implementationReadings.reading: Start with Slash/Dodge/Peach, normalize elemental Slash to Slash. Printed physical entities actually entering DiscardPile accumulate globally throughout each actual turn, including a period when the owner did not have the skill. One complete group pays once per owner in that actual turn. Removed names remain removed for that owner across loss and reacquisition.
implementationReadings.classification: published text plus current extension and role-state observation; cross-source lifetime is an implementation inference

implementationReadings.reading: The name entering DiscardPile is the physical entity printed name, not a virtual converted output. A nonBasic material used as Slash does not add Slash; a Basic material used as another output retains its printed name. Only actual DiscardPile arrivals count; replacement movement elsewhere does not.
implementationReadings.classification: literal physical-entry reading; no exclusive conversion FAQ

implementationReadings.reading: A true CardUse payment/finish or true native Dodge, Nullification and rescue response use is Use. Duel Slash, AOE replies and faction pure Played are not converted into true Use merely because the finish reason says ResponseFinished. Native processing entry, original payment and exact finish-parent proof distinguish them. Claimed declaration invoices are preserved.
implementationReadings.classification: native engine action semantics applied to the official Use wording; no character-exclusive FAQ

implementationReadings.topic: The complete first group and non-Use flag
implementationReadings.reading: Freeze the current remaining group when its first full threshold is reached. Any matching arrival in that turn-prefix that was not from true Use requires one remaining name to be removed after the native Draw1 and all its children, while retaining at least one name. A single whole batch cannot pay the same owner twice.
implementationReadings.classification: text composition inference; no FAQ for duplicate same-name arrivals

implementationReadings.reading: A draft requires at least one currently discardable actual Hand Basic before payment. Freeze the entire initial atomic cost and its mandatory effective Basic names, then request native Draw1 repeatedly without another discard selection. NonBasic gains continue; an obtained Basic name absent from the fixed initial name set stops. Names are not taken from all other discards that turn. Slash variants normalize to Slash.
implementationReadings.classification: explicit implementation inference combining published wording and ACTIVE-only/minimum-one client selector; not a dedicated official FAQ

implementationReadings.topic: Five-request upper bound and empty outcomes
implementationReadings.reading: At most five native one-card requests are made. Stop issuing new requests after an empty actual outcome, owner death or game completion. An already-paid child must drain before returning. These are request-count and native-liveness interpretations, not a claim that a replacement is an ActualDraw entity.

Native replacement obtained entities remain ReplacementGainedIds, never ActualDrawIds. Both kinds of actual gains participate in the stop-name test and hand-limit exemption. A replacement program and its own children complete before the native operation callback issues the exemption invoice; ordinary drawn-card observers run under the owning continuation after that callback.
implementationReadings.classification: native typed-return contract plus explicit interpretation of 因此获得; no character-specific replacement FAQ

implementationReadings.reading: Each exact actual gained entity is exempt while in the original beneficiary Hand during the same actual turn. Transfer does not benefit another owner; original-beneficiary reacquisition within the same actual turn retains that entity right. Skill loss after payment does not cancel the paid cycle or exemption, and source loss never causes repayment. Dead owners drain paid children but receive no fresh request.
implementationReadings.classification: exact-entity ownership/actual-turn and paid-continuation implementation inference

implementationReadings.reading: The initial cost is paid once by the real native atomic discard invocation. An existing exact Hell Shiyou replacement can redirect a paid cost to its proven destination without inventing a DiscardPile arrival or logical discard count. Arbitrary foreign transfers do not satisfy the cost invoice.
implementationReadings.classification: existing native movement-replacement contract, not a new character rule

runtimeDesign.owningFrame: ProgramSkillFrame.XieLingYu nullable and omitted when absent; all selected/material/gain collections are frozen on assignment.
runtimeDesign.events: Only scalar fact payloads; no parallel pending object or use-ID sidecar.
runtimeDesign.nativeDraw: BeginOperationProgramDraw and exact operation return, with paid movement/native attempt/HP/recovery/skills observer subtree drain.
runtimeDesign.initialPicker: Zero-input activation opens a private draft; the current client minimum one applies at actual payment, not a fake zero-card success. Canceling the draft does not spend the actual Play token.
runtimeDesign.privacy: Cost identities are owner-only; remaining-name decision is private, completed name removal is publicly logged. Existing snapshot visibility governs gained entities and the 心幽 mark.
runtimeDesign.replayCompatibility: No global epoch, skill schema or package version change; the absent nullable owning-frame field preserves old serialization.
